questions.question: CAD data for fabrication should be accompanied by:
options: Only a verbal description left on the fab’s voicemail.
Textual fabrication specifications and clear process notes.
A selfie of the monitor showing the auto-router progress bar.
Nothing - Gerbers alone never need notes or tolerances.
questions.explanation: CAD data must be accompanied by textual fabrication specifications

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: PCB Documentation Finishing the routing, drilling, and design-checking completes only the graphic portion of a design, but there are other aspects of the design which the CAD data cannot address alone.

questions.question: Drill files in the manufacturing package should be:
options: Hand-drawn sketches without hole sizes.
Industry-standard Excellon drill files reflecting finished hole sizes.
Optional if the board uses only slots and no holes.
Named randomly so competitors cannot find them.
questions.explanation: Excellon drill files which reflect finished hole sizes

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFInclude industry standard, Excellon drill files which reflect finished hole sizes.

questions.question: Board outline thickness tolerance guidance in the notes includes:
options: ±10% for boards ≥0.039 in and a wider ±15% range for thinner boards (work with mechanical stakeholders).
Zero tolerance on thickness for every consumer toy PCB.
No thickness tolerance because laminate never varies.
±90% so any core in inventory can be used blindly.

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Work with mechanical stakeholders to allow a PCB thickness tolerance of +/-10% for boards .039[0.99] thickness and greater and +/-15% range for a PCB thickness less than .039 [0.99].

questions.question: Holes ≤0.200 in are generally designated to be ____; larger are ____.
options: routed; drilled.
drilled; routed
ignored; plated only
laser-only; never machined

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Holes larger than .250[6.35] are typically routed (not drilled) and need tolerancing like those applied to a routed board outline edge.

questions.question: Intelligent data formats mentioned when IP rules allow include:
options: Only JPEG screenshots of the layout canvas.
IPC-2581, ODB++, or ASCII, ideally with source design database when permitted.
Only screenshot PNGs of the layout canvas exported at screen resolution.
Encrypted MP3s of the auto-router log file.

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Intelligent source database formats are best output in IPC-2581 or ODB++ because they provide the most usable information to the board fabricator and assembly processor.

questions.question: File naming guidance for manufacturing outputs:
options: Use part number, revision, and file function in a tangible convention.
Name every file final_final2_reallyfinal.gbr.
Omit revision so fabs always build the newest mystery version.
Use spaces and reserved shell characters so CAM tools fail to open them.
questions.explanation: part number, revision, and file function

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: File Naming Convention Avoid using non-descript or vague names like “TOP.GBR” for files.

questions.question: True or false: Include a complete fabrication drawing in the manufacturing data package.

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: FFInclude a complete fabrication drawing in the manufacturing data package.

questions.question: If intentional shorts exist, documentation should:
options: Hide them and hope CAM never asks.
Show X,Y locations and net names in a table so the supplier’s question is answered early.
Delete the nets entirely from the fab drawing.
Only mention them in a private Slack DM after award.
questions.explanation: If intentional shorts exist in the design

reference.book: The Hitchhiker's Guide to PCB Design
reference.excerpt: Tab-route Detail Intentional Shorts Table Like the V-Score detail, the tab-route detail is only provided if there is in-house assembly processing.
